About the Certification
What Is the AI Red Teaming Professional Certification (AIRTP+)?
The AI Red Teaming Professional (AIRTP+) certification assesses AI red teaming knowledge through practical questions and challenges involving large language models (LLMs). Topics include prompt injection, jailbreaking, and AI security defenses. Passing the exam earns the AIRTP+ credential from Learn Prompting.
You can purchase an exam attempt on its own or prepare with the on-demand course bundle. New to the field? Start with our free guide, What Is AI Red Teaming?

Put AI Red Teaming Knowledge into Practice
Prepare to investigate how an AI system behaves, explain a security finding, and reason about the limits of a defense.
Investigate an attack
Understand how prompt injection and jailbreaking can redirect model behavior. Practice within an authorized environment and record the inputs and outputs you observe.
Explain the result
Describe what happened, why it matters, and how someone else could reproduce it. Distinguish an observed result from an assumption about the system.
Evaluate a defense
Compare an attack with a proposed mitigation. Consider where the defense helps, where it can fail, and which legitimate uses it might affect.

Frequently Asked Questions
How much does the AIRTP+ certification cost?
The AIRTP+ exam alone costs $299 and includes one exam attempt. The On-Demand Course + Exam bundle costs $1,199 and includes the AI Red Teaming Masterclass plus two exam attempts.
What format is the AIRTP+ certification exam?
The AIRTP+ exam is a hands-on, 24-hour online exam that tests practical AI red teaming skills, including prompt injection, jailbreaking, and AI security defenses against real AI systems.
Who is the AIRTP+ exam designed for?
AIRTP+ is designed for cybersecurity professionals and AI practitioners who want to assess their AI red teaming skills. Familiarity with large language models, prompt injection, and jailbreaking will help you prepare. The on-demand AI Red Teaming Masterclass is an optional preparation route.
What if I fail the professional exam on my first attempt?
The course bundle includes two exam attempts, while the exam-only option includes one. If you do not pass, review your result before attempting the exam again. For help with your remaining attempts or access, contact [email protected].
Who issues the AIRTP+ certification?
AIRTP+ is issued by Learn Prompting, which publishes AI education and research and organizes HackAPrompt. The certification is earned by passing the AIRTP+ exam.
How do I access my professional exam?
Follow the exam-access instructions provided with your purchase and check that your exam credit is available before you begin. Once you start an attempt, the 24-hour timer runs continuously. Contact [email protected] if you need help accessing your account or credit.
What if I need special accommodations?
Please contact our support team at [email protected]. We strive to make the exam accessible to everyone.
Are there group or enterprise licenses available?
Yes. Contact [email protected] for a quote for multiple course seats or exam attempts. Tell us how many learners you want to enroll and which option you are considering.
